title: Exclusive-Apple supplier Tata tightens internal controls after data breach, sources say
title_zh: 消息人士称，苹果独家供应商塔塔在数据泄露后加强内部控制
summary: Tata Electronics, a key Indian supplier to Apple, has restricted internal access to sensitive systems as it investigates a leak of thousands of secret client files on the dark web, a Tata source and two industry officials said.
summary_zh: 塔塔消息人士和两名行业官员表示，苹果的印度主要供应商塔塔电子在调查暗网上泄露的数千份秘密客户文件时，限制了对敏感系统的内部访问。

title: Memory chip shortage is pushing Apple prices higher
title_zh: 内存芯片短缺导致苹果价格上涨
